name: Skyworks Solutions, Inc.
moat_justification: Real design-win franchise and RF scale, but returns prove erosion: ROIC proxy down from 22.7% to 8.9% over five fiscal years, gross margin down ~8 points, sockets re-bid each generation, and two-thirds of revenue sits with one customer that just dual-sourced a premier socket. A 4 sits on measured returns at/below the cost of capital, not on the historical franchise.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 12 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 5.63 vs 3-yr median 9.11 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
one_liner: RF front-end franchise in structural erosion, moat 4/10 - does not clear 15% on the latest-FY base (8.4% weighted IRR, IV $38.55 vs $79.70 price); clears 15% only below ~$39, and the Qorvo combination that closed 2026-10-05 makes even that a standalone-basis figure pending combined filings.
moat_for: RF front-end oligopoly: deep design-win integration in flagship Apple and Android phones, with in-house GaAs manufacturing
Patent estate (~5,200 patents standalone per the company IR page; 12,000+ issued and pending combined after the Qorvo close)
Broad Markets diversification is working: ~43% of Q3 FY2026 revenue, up 8% year over year, led by automotive and data center
Qorvo combination (closed 2026-10-05) adds scale across RF, analog and power and removes a direct rival
moat_against: Largest customer ~67% of FY2025 revenue and ~57% of Q3 FY2026 revenue, and that customer dual-sourced a premier RF socket for the iPhone 17 (20-25% content loss)
ROIC proxy fell from 22.7% (FY2020/21) to 8.9% (FY2025); gross margin fell from 49.2% (FY2021) to 41.2% (FY2025) and 40.7% TTM
Sockets are re-competed every phone generation; Qualcomm bundles RF with Snapdragon and Broadcom holds premium filter slots
Revenue fell three straight fiscal years (FY2023-25) on handset maturity and content losses
Qorvo integration risk: ~$2B of acquisition debt added and $500M+ of claimed synergies are unproven
